en: Colorized street view of a broad avenue with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and horse‑drawn carriages. A cast‑iron fence lines a park or garden on the right; historic buildings rise beyond, including a classical structure with a rooftop belvedere. Legends printed below the image read in Russian and French: "Москва - Moscou" and "Знаменка - Rue Znamenka." Publisher credit appears at lower left.
